issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. The diff only changes the perturbation step of the basin-hopping loop: about 30% of the time it rescales the radii by a log-normal factor, repairs them with finalize() and gives SLSQP 150 iterations; otherwise it keeps the old move of jittering 1 to 4 centers. There is no file or network access and no pasted coordinates.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. The radius-rescale move puts positions back in [0, 1] and caps radii at 0.5 before finalize(). The final packing is still checked by the harness with zero tolerance. The loop is still limited to 200 seconds, and the extra 50 SLSQP iterations per hop only add a little time to the last hop.

The z value can't be checked. There is one candidate run (-2.636) and one incumbent run (-2.6360), so there is no variance estimate. The two values match at the precision shown. The harness's z = -0.001 must use an assumed noise scale, and it is far too small to count as an improvement. Rejecting is consistent with the numbers.

A sum of 2.636 is a little above the 2.635 quoted on the card, but the known best value is about 2.6359 when rounded more finely, so this matches it rather than beating it. Not suspicious. Replicate runs are needed before claiming any gain.
